test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

The liberal leadership simply joined the ranks of the existing __government by the few.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Oligarchy"** means a small group of people having control of a country, organization, or institution. (अल्पतंत्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The country was ruled by an **oligarchy**, with only a few families holding all the power.
 
 
 
• **"Oligarchy" **refers to a system where power rests with a small number of people, typically the wealthy or well-connected. (अल्पतंत्र)
 
 
• **Example: **The liberal leadership simply joined the ranks of the existing government by the few, thus supporting the **oligarchy.**
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct substitute for** 'the existing government by the few'** is **'Oligarchy'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Plutocracy **(धनतंत्र): Government by the wealthy.

 
 
• **Example:** The nation was criticized for being a plutocracy where only the rich had influence over political decisions.
 
 
 
• **Democracy **(लोकतंत्र): A system of government by the whole population, typically through elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example: **India is the world's largest democracy.
 
 
 
• **Autocracy** (एकतंत्र): A system of government by one person with absolute power.
 
 
• **Example:** The country suffered under the autocracy of a ruthless dictator.

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**</p&g
